primitive: Recursive algebraic data types must remain type-safe through default trait derivation and both Jet execution tiers.
evidence: scripts/agent/jet-env jet run examples/features/types/recursive_enum.jet -> E0112 (_jet_derive_equal_Expr wants Expr but got Expr<>) and E0401 (fallible Bool/Ordering used without handling); the shipped 9-line recursive Expr example cannot run.
workaround: Use a flat postfix token list or an explicit heap/index representation; the symbolic probe uses a flat [Node] code instead of recursive Expr.

primitive: Native code generation must lower named-payload enum pattern tests in imported library modules.
evidence: scripts/agent/jet-env jet build /home/nate/.cache/jet-luna/dx3/prim-dsl/pkg/symbolic2_demo.jet -> internal compiler error: typed IR does not cover statement `if` at symbolic2.jet:9:5, compiler bug (I2/R7), crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/Items.rs:3409:5.
workaround: Wrap the named payload in one struct and match the single payload; that workaround built and ran in the earlier symbolic2 probe.

primitive: Provide a value-producing filter pipeline over dynamic trees: path selection, array mapping, and composable pipe stages.
evidence: The jq-shaped workload needs a 28-line filter.jet walker with explicit DataTree.Object/Array matches, map lookup, optional handling, and a loop; scripts/agent/jet-env jet run .../prim_dsl_filter_demo.jet -> [3, 8]. jq's equivalent is a short `.items[] | .price` pipeline.
workaround: Write ordinary DataTree walkers and list/map loops; the probe is safe and native-buildable, but every filter operator must be authored manually.

primitive: Provide compiler/runtime support for formula dependency graphs, topological ordering, and dirty transitive incremental recomputation.
evidence: The 58-line formula.jet probe manually stores deps, fixes an evaluation order, propagates a dirty map, and records touched cells; native run prints `first total=5 touched=[a, b, total]` and `second total=11 touched=[a, b, total]`.
workaround: Represent formulas as structs plus maps/lists and implement dependency propagation in library code, as the probe does.

primitive: The default evaluator must execute map index-field assignment used by an incremental formula engine.
